name: Beta and volatility glossary
summary: Define beta, idiosyncratic vs systematic risk, and optionally compute sample variance of pasted returns.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Glossary plus sample variance of a return list. Beta versus a benchmark is not estimated unless you paste two aligned series into mkt-return-correlation.
